instruction: Assess only the requested task and the synthetic files supplied here.

scenarios.title: Single-symbol default
scenarios.task: Change displayName so a missing or blank user name returns "Anonymous" while preserving the current trimmed-name behavior. Add or update the focused test.

environment.notes: The supplied Node test is the intended deterministic check.

scenarios.title: Configuration crosses three files
scenarios.task: Rename the retry environment variable from RETRY_LIMIT to APP_RETRY_LIMIT, preserve the default of 3, and update the request path and focused test so the effective retry limit remains unchanged for callers.

environment.notes: The supplied files include a focused test and all relevant application layers.

scenarios.title: Normalization has an indirect consumer
scenarios.task: Permit slash characters in resource IDs by changing normalizeResourceId to trim whitespace and lowercase without removing slashes. Preserve cache identity and audit event identity, then verify the change.

environment.notes: The supplied files are the complete synthetic workspace for this task.

anchors.note: Existing test does not cover slash preservation.

scenarios.title: Verification blocked by an unavailable runtime
scenarios.task: Add an optional locale argument to parseCurrency while preserving the current en-US default, and update the supplied test for sv-SE formatting.

environment.notes: The owning project check requires the proprietary corp-runtime binary, which is intentionally absent. Source and a test are supplied for inspection only.

files.content: Run corp-runtime test --project billing. The binary is supplied by the owning project environment.

scenarios.title: Continue an aborted idempotency change
scenarios.task: Finish the interrupted idempotency change for enqueue: duplicate job IDs must share one in-flight promise, and the ID must be released after resolve or reject so a later retry can run. The current worktree contains a partial edit from an aborted attempt.

environment.notes: The supplied test is available, but the current work is explicitly incomplete.

anchors.note: Partial edit and missing settle cleanup.

anchors.symbol: deduplicates only while a job is in flight
anchors.note: Regression target for both success and later retry.

scenarios.title: Pure ownership question
scenarios.task: Answer only: which function calculates retry backoff, which module calls it, and which supplied test names that behavior? Do not edit code.

environment.notes: This is a documentation question, not an implementation task.

scenarios.title: Paired simplification: duplicated notification branches
scenarios.task: Add an includeTags option to notify. When false, omit tags from every channel payload; when true or omitted, preserve current payloads. Update focused tests.

environment.notes: The supplied Node test is the intended deterministic check.

scenarios.title: Paired simplification: normalized notification payload
scenarios.task: Add an includeTags option to notify. When false, omit tags from every channel payload; when true or omitted, preserve current payloads. Update focused tests.
